subject: Service honorarium & trial extension for Horizon Retail outage
messages:
From: Dana Brooks <dana@horizonretail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Spike and partial outage during Friday deploy — need remediation

Hey Vivek,

We experienced a significant latency spike and partial request failures starting 2026-05-22 13:40 UTC during your team's rolling deploy. Our storefront search traffic saw 5–10x error rates for ~18 minutes and elevated p95 latency for another 40 minutes after. This severely impacted peak shopping activity and we incurred downstream CDN retries.

Can you share timeline of the incident, whether this was a known regression, and what remediation you can offer? We'd like to understand next steps and any compensatory measures — Horizon has a 60-day trial running and this incident materially impacts our evaluation.

I've attached our access logs and a small summary of API error windows.

Thanks,
Dana Brooks
Director, Platform Engineering
Horizon Retail
Attachments: horizon-usage-report-May.csv (csv, 2.1MB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Brooks <dana@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike and partial outage during Friday deploy — need remediation

Dana —

Thanks for flagging this and for the quick data (appreciate the CSV). I'm really sorry Horizon hit that regression during a critical window. We're investigating on our side but I wanted to respond quickly with next steps:

- I'm looping in Marissa (Customer Success) and Sean (SRE) to pull the full timeline and root cause.
- We'll deliver a detailed incident timeline and a proposed mitigation plan by EOD Friday (my target: 2026-05-29 17:00 UTC).
- In the meantime, I'd like to propose an immediate gesture: a one-month trial extension plus a $12,000 service honorarium in platform credits to offset impact to your testing and the traffic costs. If that sounds reasonable, we'll route approvals today.

Please let me know if you want that routed to your procurement contact for a formal credit memo.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Spike and partial outage during Friday deploy — need remediation

Vivek / Sean —

Quick notes from SRE after preliminary dig: rolling deploy touched a new KV-cache eviction change that increased cold-cache p95 under certain burst patterns. We rolled it back at 13:59 UTC which removed the errors but prefix cache fills prolonged p95 for ~40m. Impact looks limited to the search route for Horizon (subset of tokens).

Approvals: I can authorize a one-month trial extension out of CS discretionary budget. For the $12k honorarium, I'll need Sales Ops approval to attach a credit to deal DEAL-9341 and sign-off from finance for recognition. Suggest we offer a $12k credit plus a formal SLA incident summary and a technical postmortem within 72 hours.

I'll draft the postmortem. Sean — can you confirm rollback window and add the exact error codes for Dana's timeline?

-Marissa
Customer Success Manager

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spike and partial outage during Friday deploy — need remediation

Marissa / Vivek —

Confirmed: rollback executed at 2026-05-22T13:59:10Z. Error window 2026-05-22T13:40:18Z–2026-05-22T13:59:10Z (approx 18m) with 502/504 spikes on the search route. Elevated p95 continued until ~2026-05-22T14:42:00Z due to cache warming and higher CPU on the node pool handling TTL churn.

I'll attach the internal SLA timeline and the incident trace in a follow-up (sla-timeline.pdf). From engineering POV the rollback and cache-adjustment is already staged to prevent recurrence.

-Sean
Principal SRE
Attachments: sla-timeline.pdf (pdf, 450KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Brooks <dana@horizonretail.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T13:48:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: honorarium & trial extension details for Horizon Retail

Hi Dana / Tom —

Thanks again for the patience. Per the internal checks (attached timeline) we want to make this right.

Proposal summary:
- One-month free trial extension applied to your org (adds 30 days to current term).
- $12,000 platform credit applied to DEAL-9341. This will appear as a negative invoice/credit memo and can be used against usage through the next 180 days.
- Formal incident postmortem & technical notes delivered by 2026-06-01.

Next steps for formalization:
1) If this is acceptable, reply with the procurement contact to route a credit memo. We can also send a DocuSign acknowledgement if required.
2) If procurement prefers an alternate credit amount or a different grant structure (token top-up vs monthly credit), let us know and we'll work through it.

Attaching: sla-timeline.pdf. I've copied Monica (Finance) and Marissa (CS) for billing and postmortem.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: sla-timeline.pdf

From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@horizonretail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Brooks <dana@horizonretail.com>, Horizon Retail Procurement <procurement@horizonretail.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: honorarium & trial extension details for Horizon Retail

Vivek —

Appreciate the quick investigation and the offer. Procurement (procurement@horizonretail.com) will need a credit memo and simple acknowledgement. Please send the DocuSign if you can; I'll route internally once it's received. Also confirm the credit expires in 180 days from issuance.

Also please cc our account team (I've included procurement) on the DocuSign so they have the invoice reference.

Thanks,
Tom Lee
Head of Platform Operations
Horizon Retail
